contracts.case_spec: frozen dataclass: case_id, group_id, expected: Literal["positive","negative"], scene: SceneSpec, task: GroundingTaskDescriptor, request_id, point_cap:int, paid_cap:int. No truth-derived online fields.
contracts.cli: subcommands preregister, run-group --group G1|G2|G3 --registry --output --model-directory --asset-manifest --model-store --profile-id --gpu-lock --allow-paid, summarize; no case filter, repeats, mutable cap or resume flags; launcher --preflight invokes original R545 configure_overlay only. run-group uses the frozen registry, never regenerates its contents.
contracts.explicit_tasks: For each fixed color c above: instruction="Move the {c} block to the green region.", target_phrase="{c} block", destination_phrase="green region", target_label="{c} block". These are static user-task choices, not derived from rendered labels, points, scene parameters or instance data.
contracts.scene_parameters: All design.md positions/sizes/camera/light/depth settings preserved. Object mass=.08kg, friction=1, seed=0; COLORS from existing scene_sampler for red/blue/yellow, destination [.1,.6,.2,1], N03 destination [.5,.5,.5,1]. SceneSpec.from_parameters with frozen model asset SHA. N04 yellow is a distractor; paused floating synthetic visibility stress, no stability claim.
contracts.request: Unique fixed r558-<case_id.lower()> request_id; explicit task instruction; observation from actual capture; SceneSummary(scene_version=1, updated_at=observation.captured_at) with empty objects/regions/obstacles/robot_state; RobotCapabilities supported_skills explicitly HOME,MOVE_ABOVE,APPROACH,GRASP,LIFT,MOVE_TO_REGION,PLACE,RELEASE,RETREAT and existing defaults for numeric capabilities. No ground-truth positions/labels in request. Save full validated original request before process.
contracts.production_reuse: Existing factory and selected ModelControlService/profile/secret store; factory allow_paid=True only in explicitly authorized run-group, unchanged snapshot/settings/security. Each case constructs its own adapter and pipeline. Positive supplier captures the same session once; negative supplier=None. Wrap and return original pipeline response unchanged. Copy only for report serialization, never manufacture PLANNED.
contracts.ledger: One fresh output root; frozen registry SHA and complete source/settings/asset identity manifest before model load. flock on root ledger.lock plus exclusive per-group claim; refuse any prior claim (including crash). Exclusive fsynced numbered reservation file before delegation, enforce registry group/case membership, case order, 3 total group load reservations, per-group1 load, point8/6/6, N2/P4 and P1/group1/total3 paid. Capture/load/point/paid starts and completions are distinct events; conservative point/load reservation may precede actual native start and cannot be recycled. Provider generation_limit remains8/6/6 and its actual native counters are reconciled separately. On ledger persistence failure do not delegate; stop group. Unknown/overlapping output root/registry drift fails before loading.
contracts.worker_lifetime: Exactly3 sequential separately launched processes. Main thread, reuse existing CLI _admit_resources context without editing it; same existing shared GPU lock, source identity checks and HF offline/local cache settings. One resident MolmoPointProvider per group, distinct per-case recording proxy references to that resident instance. Each case with MuJoCoCaptureSession and once apply_scene before capture; no step, OfflineSceneAdapter, settling or frame-time rewrites. setup resets allowed only before initial capture. Independent safe cases continue after a recorded case failure; provider/load/ledger/resource corruption stops group and marks remaining fixed rows NOT_RUN. No group/case restart.
contracts.observation_wrappers: Point proxy reserves before calling real point(), saves binding/status/raw hash and returns same BoundPointResult. Per-case cloud _request_visual wrapper records entry; N immediately records blocked cloud entry and raises without delegating or paying. P delegates unchanged args and returns same real full response. Per-case _post wrapper additionally enforces hard paid cap and route, durably reserves before delegating original _post; errors consume reservations, no retry. Restore observational wrappers in finally. Observation-only local-stage wrappers may record actual associate_target_point / ground_observation / tracker-constructor entry/return/exception and delegate originals identically; no substituted result/exception or threshold. Do not derive classifier success from reason-string guess alone.

classification.priority: Any accounting/unknown/duplicate/capture-gap problem => INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE or INVALID_SUITE, never PASS. Any negative cloud entry or harness budget interception => FAIL_CLOUD_GATE_REACHED or FAIL_BUDGET_BLOCK, regardless returned sentinel. Runtime/parser/binding/freshness exceptions are ERROR or FAIL, never expected visual rejection.
classification.positive: PASS_PLANNED only actual PLANNED, contract!=None, response validation true, local post_cloud_revalidation PASSED, final_plan_admission PASSED, 4 actual valid bound native POINT queries over2 actual same-session captures,1 actual paid response, no evidence gaps; other outcomes FAIL_* with real layer recorded.
classification.negative: PASS_EXPECTED_REJECTION only actual REQUEST_MORE_OBSERVATION, contract=None, cloud_entry=0/paid=0, no harness block/runtime error, and either recorded valid native ABSENT (source=model_absence) or genuine original association/grounding/tracker geometric rejection with valid native POINTs obtained up to that stage (source=program_geometry). Native INVALID/malformed or native exception does not count. Context/calibration/checksum/TTL/resource/capture/serialization errors never count as expected scene rejection. Report causal gate and all actual point statuses; do not claim ambiguity/occlusion specifically proved merely from ABSENT.
classification.summary: Exactly7 preregistered IDs; positives denominator3, negatives denominator4, overall7. Missing=>NOT_RUN/INCOMPLETE; duplicate/unknown IDs invalidate summary without dropping rows. Keep individual outcomes, observed counts, reserved counts, unspent budget and stop reasons. CPU regression coverage is a separate table, never added to7.

contracts.evidence: All original request/task/scene configs, both captures (RGB, raw float32 depth, mask, calibration/time/checksum), provider-generated native full text/prompt/tokenIDs, actual cloud body/full response/usage/model, actual original pipeline response/contract, settings/source/asset hashes, UTC+monotonic boundaries, counters and exceptions kept under ignored local root. Record missing HTTP numeric status as NOT_CAPTURED if existing transport does not expose it. No credentials/auth headers. Final manifest verifies every local raw file size/SHA and detects missing event closure; durable reservation originals never overwritten. Public registry contains fixed meta/config/input hashes and expected categories only; reports explicitly not a complete remote raw package.
contracts.cpu_tests: RED/GREEN harness budget, group claims, ordering, negative classification, original-return identity, persistence/crash accounting, source leak tests. Existing test_molmo_grounded_planner/test_molmo_revalidation/test_molmo_final_admission/test_molmo_grounded_cli/test_rgbd_capture_session supply CPU fault sources; no assertion that their injected failures occurred in actual7cases. Seven real MuJoCo setup/capture preflights may run CPU without native model/cloud, with capture cleanup and no motion. Do not alter scenes after seeing actual model outcomes.
contracts.run_gate: 24 frozen input hashes still match; harness tests and scoped Ruff/diff pass; one fresh independent implementation review; original R545 configure_overlay and new module import identity, original26 model asset hashes/runtime ABI; selected unchanged Sol profile/settings/secret presence; main-thread/resource/shared-lock/exclusive-root admission each process; no install/download/profile switch. Stop repairs for new unplanned root causes and obtain actual Astra plan.
